insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured and limits as per Policy Schedule; NCB up to 100%; ReAssure unlimited with per-claim cap up to Base Sum Insured)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “The first paid claim triggers ReAssure, a benefit with unlimited sum insured. NOTE: Maximum amount ReAssure benefit pays for any single claim is up to base sum insured.”
great.explanation: After your first paid claim, you get an additional sum insured called ReAssure that can pay further claims in the same policy year, effectively giving extra cover once the base sum insured is used.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is standard in the market.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.reference: Section 5.1(II) Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
good.explanation: Specified diseases and procedures are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is standard.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except for accidents, which are covered from day one; this is the market standard.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: “For every claim free year, we will add 10% of expiring policy base sum insured as NCB, maximum up to 100%.”
good.explanation: Your sum insured increases by 10% each claim-free year up to 100%, but it is unclear if this bonus reduces or resets after a claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “The default co-payment in the product is 50% which You can modify to 40% or 30% or 20% at inception of the first policy.”
bad.explanation: By default, you pay 50% of every admissible claim unless you choose a lower co-pay at inception; even the lowest available 20% is a significant out-of-pocket expense.

bad.name: Co-pay (Room Upgrade)
bad.quote: “You will have to bear additional 10% co-payment IF treatment is taken in higher room category than the eligible room category as specified in Your Policy Schedule”
bad.explanation: If you choose a higher room category than your eligibility, you must pay an extra 10% co-pay on admissible expenses, increasing your share of the bill.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: “All applicable benefits and details are mentioned in your Policy Schedule.”
bad.explanation: The policy wording does not specify the eligible room category or room rent limits, making it impossible to assess your potential cost-sharing risks.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Annexure I – The expenses that are not covered ... List I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ... 68 VASOFIX SAFETY”
bad.reference: Annexure I – List I (Expenses not covered)
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks, and nebulisation kits are excluded, which means you will likely pay out-of-pocket for these during hospital stays.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.reference: Section 3.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered for 60 days, which is standard but not better than the market norm.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.reference: Section 3.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 180 days, which meets the market standard but does not exceed it.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments as specified below: ... Robotic surgeries ... NOTE: A limit of maximum Rs. 1,00,000 per claim will apply to all robotic surgeries, except for total radical prostatectomy, cardiac surgeries, partial nephrectomy and surgeries for malignancies.”
bad.explanation: Modern treatments are explicitly covered with a stated cap of Rs. 1,00,000 per claim for most robotic surgeries, except certain major surgeries which have no cap, offering better coverage than many senior-focused plans.

unclear.name: NCB Reset
unclear.quote: “For every claim free year, we will add 10% ... maximum up to 100%.”
unclear.explanation: The policy explains how NCB accrues but does not clarify whether it reduces or resets after a claim, so its behavior on claims is unclear.

unclear.name: Deductible
unclear.quote: “Annual Aggregate Deductible (optional benefit) ... This is an aggregate amount in a year ... which we will NOT pay.”
unclear.explanation: The deductible is optional, but the exact amount and structure are not specified here; if chosen, it affects your out-of-pocket costs.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
